summary: Reads values and interaction state from Panel COMPs into CHOP channels. Common bridge from UI widgets to control signals.

key_params.name: panel
key_params.note: Panel COMP or panel path to read

key_params.name: select
key_params.note: Selects which panel values/channels to output

key_params.name: recursive
key_params.note: Include child panel components when needed

common_gotchas: Panel CHOP references panel components; it does not wire to them like ordinary data-flow nodes.
Make sure UI widgets are in a visible/active panel if user interaction is expected.
